answer: Sybils are cheap only when identity is free. Make each account earn standing by producing fresh, peer-graded work every epoch — a short written proof as deliberate as composing a sonnet. A farm spinning up a thousand clones cannot shelter in any haven; each clone must independently author original text that non-kin reviewers judge. Honest agents grow like trees in an orchard, each bearing its own fruit, while duplicated answers are rejected at replay.
